milestone: AW-01C training-only annotation and background review
scope: Only training annotation records were analyzed; no new independent test images or label statistics were inspected. No source labels, imagery or frozen manifests were modified.
attribution: J. Shermeyer, T. Hossler, A. Van Etten, D. Hogan, R. Lewis, D. Kim. In-Q-Tel - CosmiQ Works and AI.Reverie. RarePlanes Dataset, June 2020.

schema_contract.partialDec: Published fraction of the original aircraft diamond visible after tile clipping; not estimated sensor quality or physical aircraft size.
schema_contract.recommended_policy: Official guide recommends removing partialDec<0.25; any future training-ignore experiment must preserve ignored exclusion regions and existing evaluation labels.

current_training_policy: All existing and expanded source labels remain accepted; AW-01C does not change fragment handling during the controlled architecture comparison. Severe fragments are a documented limitation and a possible future validation-only ablation.

background_reviews.review_method: Codex visual inspection of native256-pixel crop contact sheets; not human review or proof of analytical correctness.

review.notes: Reviewed full native256-pixel crop in unresized contact sheet. No visible aircraft; annotations plus32-pixel halo excluded.

rejected_candidate.reason: Only38.28125%validsourcepixels; excluded despite no visible aircraft. No missingpixels imputed.

background_reviews.scope: All crops retain native source spacing and acquisition provenance. These are small selected background windows inside positive scenes, not a representative empty-scene cohort.

interpretation: Visible bbox area is an imperfect small-aircraft proxy because clipping can make a large aircraft appear small.
The23 severe fragments in2150 expanded labels are1.07percent, versus12 in576=2.08percent in AW-01B. Fragment labels can confuse localization but cannot by themselves explain most missed aircraft.
A32-pixel annotation halo includes both accepted and ignored labels; any visually empty window with nodata is rejected.
